analysis: If 16m passes once, production cap remains unset because >=5 clean near-cap runs are required.
If 16m credibly fails while 14m remains clean, the first bracket becomes [14m,16m] and refinement should test ~15m.
If 16m is under-target or independently fails, keep 14m lower bound and repeat 16m without narrowing.
complexity_rule: Do not introduce adaptive admission until a fixed reserve policy has enough close-overhead evidence to evaluate.
